scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Oh...!
You're {0} !
You've grown so much!
I'm truly proud of you.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
哦...！
是你啊，{0}！
你成長了許多！
真讓我欣慰。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
May you
always be blessed...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
願祝福永遠與你同在...

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Welcome, little one.
Fate must have brought
us together so that we'd
meet today. It's nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
歡迎，小傢伙。
命運讓我們在今天相遇，真是很高興見到你。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
You're looking for someone
that handles things with Archers
at the church? Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
你在找教堂裡負責弓箭手相關事務的人？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Oh my, you seem
to be growing quickly
into your role as an Acolyte.
Was the training difficult?
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
天哪，你作為服事的成長速度真快。
訓練辛苦嗎？

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
You are such a good person,
a true child of the light. I hope that many others will benefit from the purity of your heart and mind.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
你真是個善良的人，是真正的光之子。我希望更多人能從你純淨的心靈中受益。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
You must now find
your own path and become
a better Acolyte using
your own strength.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
現在，你必須找到自己的道路，憑藉自己的力量成為一名更優秀的服事。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Sister Asthe in the Saint Capitolina Convent is such
a sincere and loving person.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
聖卡波利納修女院的阿斯忒修女是個非常真誠且充滿愛心的人。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
But I am concerned that
you may not know what to do
as an Acolyte from here on...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
不過，我擔心你還不知道，接下來該怎麼走好服事這條路...

scripts.text: I'm not worried.
scripts.translation: 我不擔心

scripts.text: What should I do?
scripts.translation: 我該做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Seeing your eyes filled with such determination assures me. But if you run into any trouble, feel free to ask me for help. Good bye for now, blessed child.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
看到你眼中充滿鬥志，讓我很安心。
但如果你遇到麻煩，隨時可以向我求助。
再見了，受祝福的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
There is a convent northeast
of Prontera called the Saint Capitolina Convent. Go there and look for ^3131FF Sister Asthe^000000. She is a sweet and gentle soul who has
much to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
普隆德拉東北方有一座聖卡波利納修女院。
去找那裡的^3131FF阿斯忒修女^000000吧。
她溫柔善良，有很多東西可以教你。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
I look forward to seeing you
become a better Acolyte after learning from Sister Asthe's instructions. If you like, I can send you to the convent.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
我很期待看到你在阿斯忒修女的指導下成為一名更優秀的服事。
如果你願意，我可以送你到修女院。

scripts.text: Go to the convent.
scripts.translation: 去修女院

scripts.text: Do not go.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Please say hello
to Sister Asthe for me.
Have a safe trip, little one...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
請替我問候阿斯忒修女。
一路順風，小傢伙...

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
If you'd like,
I can send you to
the convent at anytime.
Whenever you feel like
you need help, come to me.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
如果你願意，我隨時都可以送你到修女院。
當你覺得需要幫助時，就來找我吧。

scripts.text:
You're looking for someone
that handles things with Archers
at the church? Hmm...
scripts.translation:
你在找負責處理弓箭手事務的人嗎？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Ah, he's away at the convent right now. If you want to meet Bishop Maugins in the Saint Capitolina Convent, travel ^3131FFnorth^000000, ^3131FFeast^000000, ^3131FFeast^000000 and then ^3131FFeast^000000 from Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
啊，他現在在修女院。如果你想見聖卡波利納修女院的主教 莫金斯，從普隆德拉出發，向^3131FF北^000000、^3131FF東^000000、^3131FF東^000000，然後再向^3131FF東^000000走。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
You have something
to give me? Oh yes, the
receipt! I was wondering
what had happened. Thank
you for all of your trouble.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
有東西要給我？
哦，對，是收據！
我還在想怎麼一直沒收到呢。
謝謝，辛苦你了。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Oh my, oh my.
It's been a while.
I wonder if there is
anything I can give you?
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
哎呀，哎呀，好久不見。
讓我想想，有沒有什麼能送給你的...

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
How about one of these?
I know I'm not offering much,
but they were quite helpful to me when I was a young Acolyte like yourself.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
這個怎麼樣？
我知道這不算什麼貴重禮物，但在我像你一樣還是年輕服事的時候，它們對我幫助很大。

scripts.text: Wand
scripts.translation: 法杖

scripts.text: Flail
scripts.translation: 連枷

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
I am worried, but I trust in your courage and affection. May you always be protected and may
you always be blessed.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
我很擔心，但我相信你的勇氣和愛心。
願神永遠保佑你，願神永遠賜福於你。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Would you like me to send you to the convent so that you can learn from this wonderful teacher?
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
你想讓我送你去修女院，向這位優秀的老師學習嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好的，麻煩你了

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Please say hello
to Sister Asthe for me.
Have a safe trip, little one...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
請替我問候阿斯忒修女。
一路順風，小傢伙...

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
If you'd like,
I can send you to
the convent at anytime.
Whenever you feel like
you need help, come to me.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 普勞頻]
如果你願意，我隨時都可以送你到修女院。
當你覺得需要幫助時，就來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh my...
How did such
a young Acolyte
manage to reach
this remote place?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哎呀...
這麼年輕的服事是怎麼來到這個偏僻的地方的？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
This castle, Saint Capitolina Convent, is a beautiful and peaceful place that brings
calm to any heart.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
聖卡波利納修女院這座城堡美麗又寧靜，能讓每個人的心都平靜下來。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
I would like to give you an assignment, but what do you
think? I believe learning the basics is your most important
task for now.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我想給你佈置個任務，你覺得如何？
不過眼下，我想最要緊的還是讓你打好基礎。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh my!
Welcome back~
I see that you've
completed the assignment
already. Good work!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哎呀！
歡迎回來~
看來你已經完成了任務。做得好！

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh my!
Welcome back~
I see that you've
completed the assignment.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哎呀！
歡迎回來~
看來你已經完成了任務。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Are you having
a hard time training
to learn Level 3 Heal?
Please don't be discouraged.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
把治癒術學到3級很辛苦嗎？
別灰心。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
I suppose I can tell you a little more about the Acolyte job. You already know that Novices must train and go to Prontera Church to become an Acolyte, your First Job Class.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我想我可以再多告訴你一些關於服事職業的事。
你已經知道，初心者必須經過訓練，並前往普隆德拉教堂才能成為服事，也就是你的一轉職業。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
{0},
I just received this letter, but it seems to have been a mistake.
It's actually addressed
to Priest Gardron.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
{0}，我剛收到這封信，好像送錯地方了。
收信人其實是加德倫牧師。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Would you please
deliver this letter
to Priest Gardron for me?
You can find him in the
building nearby.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
能幫我把信交給加德倫牧師嗎？
他就在附近那棟建築裡。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
You went to {0} on behalf of the convent for Priest Gardron? That must have been tough...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你受加德倫牧師之託，代表修女院去了{0}？
真是辛苦你了...

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
How to expel
an evil spirit?
Why, it's the same
way that you would
remove a curse...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
如何驅逐惡靈？
嗯，這和解除詛咒的方法是一樣的...

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
You remember that
you can learn Divine
Protection after learning
Blessing, right?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你記得在學會天使之賜福之後，就可以學習天使之護，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Now it's time
for your next lesson.
Let's talk about the
^3131FFIncrease AGI^000000 skill which is
part of the Heal skill tree.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
現在是時候學習下一課了。
我們來談談^3131FF加速術^000000技能，它是治癒術技能樹的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Once you learn
Level 1 Increase AGI,
you can begin learning
^3131FFDecrease AGI^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
學會1級加速術後，就可以開始學習^3131FF緩速術^000000了。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
You've been learning
really quickly. I'm glad
that we've gotten to this
point already.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你學得真快。
我很高興我們能這麼快就學到這一步了。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh dear...!
All of these things were delivered to me by accident! And some of these packages were supposed to
be sent to the Prontera Sanctuary!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哎呀...！
這些東西都是誤送到我這裡的！其中一些包裹本來是應該送到普隆德拉聖堂的！

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Okay, don't
forget the order
in which you need
to deliver the letters
and packages. That's
very important.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
記住，投遞這些信件和包裹時，順序千萬不能弄錯。
這一點很重要。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Ah, you're finishing
making all of those deliveries? Thank you very much! How was it meeting Priest Praupin after such
a long time?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
啊，信件和包裹都送完了？
太感謝了！
隔了這麼久，再見到普勞頻牧師，感覺如何？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
The last skill
I will teach you
about is ^3131FFAqua Benedicta^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我要教你的最後一個技能是^3131FF天使之淚^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
If you get into an
argument with someone,
talk it over while sharing
a nice, warm meal.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
如果跟人發生爭執，不妨一起吃頓熱騰騰的飯，再好好聊聊。

scripts.text: I came for fun.
scripts.translation: 我是來玩的

scripts.text: Priest Praupin suggested I come here.
scripts.translation: 牧師 普勞頻建議我來這裡

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
This convent is always quiet and peaceful. Sitting on the benches and feeling the almighty presense all around you is such a relaxing, meditative experience.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
這座修女院總是安靜祥和。
坐在長椅上，感受著無處不在的神聖氣息，是一種令人放鬆的冥想體驗。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Priest Praupin?
He's a very kind man
who's always thinking
about others. So he's
sent you to me for training?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
牧師 普勞頻？
他是個非常善良的人，總是為他人著想。
所以是他派你來找我接受訓練的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Before we begin,
why don't you rest
for a little bit? You must be tired after traveling all the way here. When you're ready, just come
see me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
在開始之前，你不妨先休息一下？
長途跋涉到這裡，你一定很累了。
準備好了就來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Well then...
Shall we begin
the lessons?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
那麼...
我們開始上課嗎？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
{0},
have you thought about what kind of Acolyte you would like to become? It's very important that you plan for the future that you want.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
{0}，你想過自己想成為什麼樣的服事嗎？
規劃你期望的未來是非常重要的。

scripts.text: One that supports others.
scripts.translation: 為他人提供支援

scripts.text: One that punishes evil.
scripts.translation: 懲惡揚善

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Ah, you have such
a generous heart!
Healing the pain of others and supporting your comrades in battle. You must have become an Acolyte in order to become a ^3131FFPriest^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
啊，你有一顆仁愛的心！
撫平他人的傷痛，在戰鬥中支援同伴。
你選擇成為服事，一定是想做一名^3131FF牧師^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Priests have great supportive abilities and the power to battle evil. They use weapons to battle monsters like other fighters, but are ^3131FFforbidden from using blades^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
牧師有出色的輔助能力，也有對抗邪惡的力量。
他們和其他戰士一樣，可以拿起武器對抗魔物，但^3131FF不能使用帶刃武器^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
We call those who use their fists as tools of divine punishment Monks. They deliver our message
of love and peace in a more... colorful manner.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
以雙拳執行神罰的人，我們稱為武僧。
他們傳播愛與和平的方式，更加...生動一些。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
But the path towards becoming
a Monk will require great patience and self-restraint. You'll often see Monks training their minds
and bodies throughout the land.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
但通往武僧的道路需要極大的耐心和自制力。
你經常會看到武僧在各地磨練身心。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Well, you still have a long way to go. The best thing to do would be to take your time planning and consider your future seriously.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
嗯，你還有很長的路要走。
最好的辦法是慢慢規劃，認真考慮你的未來。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Now,
{0}...
What do you think
is the most necessary
skill for an Acolyte?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
那麼，{0}...
你覺得服事最需要的技能是什麼？

scripts.text: Heal
scripts.translation: 治癒術

scripts.text: Aqua Benedicta
scripts.translation: 天使之淚

scripts.text: Teleport
scripts.translation: 瞬間移動

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Ah, yes.
^3131FFHeal ^000000 is a basic, yet important skill for people like us. It can recover your own health as
well as that of others.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
沒錯。
^3131FF治癒術^000000是我們最基礎、也很重要的技能，既能恢復自己的生命值，也能幫助別人。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
^3131FFAqua Benedicta^000000 blesses
normal water and turns it into Holy Water. This is an important skill, but not considered one of the essentials that all Acolytes
should know.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
^3131FF天使之淚^000000 可以祝福普通的水，將其轉化為聖水。這是一個重要的技能，但並不是所有服事都必須掌握的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
In my opinion,
^3131FFHeal^000000 is the most important
skill that an Acolyte can learn. It's a special ability that can save others and defeat the
monsters borne of darkness.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
在我看來，^3131FF治癒術^000000 是服事能學到的最重要的技能。這是一種特殊的能力，可以拯救他人，並擊敗由黑暗誕生的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
^3131FFTeleport^000000 allows you to instantly move to another place. It is a great skill, but it's difficult to consider it necessary for all Acolytes.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
^3131FF瞬間移動^000000 可以讓你瞬間移動到另一個地方。這是一個很棒的技能，但很難說它是所有服事都必須掌握的。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
In my opinion,
^3131FFHeal^000000 is the most important skill that an Acolyte can learn. It's a special ability that can save others and defeat the
monsters borne of darkness.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
在我看來，^3131FF治癒術^000000 是服事能學到的最重要的技能。這是一種特殊的能力，可以拯救他人，並擊敗由黑暗誕生的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
You can use the holy power
in the Heal skill to attack Undead monsters (^3131FFShift + Heal^000000). The light of truth protects the righteous and destroys the wicked.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你可以使用治癒術中的神聖力量來攻擊不死系魔物（^3131FFShift + 治癒術^000000）。真理之光保護正義，摧毀邪惡。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Just gather the
strength within your
heart into your hands...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
只需將心中的力量聚集到手中...

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
HEAL !!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
治癒術！！

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Well then, learn
the Heal skill up to
^3131FFLevel 3 ^000000 and then
return to me.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
先把治癒術學到^3131FF3級^000000，再回來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Your strength is undeveloped,
so fight weaker monsters for now.
I will lend you a Mace from the church, so use it well and ^3131FFreturn it^000000 when you're done, alright?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你還不夠強，暫時先找些較弱的魔物練習。
我會把教堂的鈍器借給你，好好使用，用完記得^3131FF還回來^000000，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
First ^0033FFstart fighting monsters around each town such as Prontera^000000. It'd be more convenient to fight the monsters here, but they might be too strong for you right now.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
首先，^0033FF去普隆德拉等城鎮周圍打打魔物^000000。在這裡打魔物會更方便，但對你來說可能太強了。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
I'll change your Save Point so that you will respawn in the convent. Once you've learned Level 3 Heal, you can use a Butterfly Wing to return here.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我會把你的儲存點設在修女院，這樣倒下後就能在這裡復活。
學會3級治癒術後，也可以用蝴蝶翅膀回到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
You can also speak to ^3131FFPriest Praupin at the Prontera Church^000000
and he will send you back here.
He takes special care in helping young Acolytes.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你也可以和^3131FF普隆德拉教堂的牧師 普勞頻^000000對話，他會把你送回來。
他特別關心年輕的服事。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Well then,
I hope you
have a safe trip.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
那麼，祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh my!
You've already
learned how to
properly use the
Heal skill. Very good!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哎呀！
你已經學會如何正確使用治癒術了。很好！

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
I believe you're
ready for me to discuss
the next subject. Now,
let's see... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
看來，可以繼續講下一課了。
讓我想想...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Now, I would like to have the Mace back, if you don't mind.
By any chance, do you carry ^FF0000any other Mace with an elemental Property^000000?
If so, please store the mace somewhere first.
I am afraid that my sight is too bad to distinguish the difference...Hoho.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
現在，該請你歸還那把鈍器了。
你身上有沒有^FF0000其他帶有屬性的鈍器^000000？
有的話，請先存到別處。
我眼神不太好，怕分辨不清...Hoho.

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Would you like me to take the mace away from your inventory now?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
要我現在從你的物品欄中把鈍器取走嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: Let me check again.
scripts.translation: 讓我再檢查一下

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Okay, no problem.
Please make sure that you do not carry any ^FF0000Mace with an elemental Property^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
好的，沒問題。
請確保你沒有攜帶任何^FF0000帶有屬性的鈍器^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Thank you so much.
You have returned the Mace.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
非常感謝。
你已經歸還了鈍器。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
But you must have forgotten the Mace I've lent you. Would you bring it back so that I can return it to the church?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
不過，你好像忘記帶上我借你的鈍器了。
能把它拿回來嗎？
我還得交還教堂呢。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
The basics are crucial to gaining mastery of the more advanced skills that you'll learn later. Just keep in mind that all of your efforts and suffering will become glory
and happiness.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
基礎對於掌握你之後將學習的高階技能至關重要。請記住，你所有的努力和苦難終將化為榮耀與幸福。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
After you become an Acolyte
at ^3131FFJob Level 40^000000, you will have the opportunity to change to a more specialized Second Job Class.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
服事達到^3131FF職業等級40^000000後，就能選擇更專精的二轉職業。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
When changing
to the Second Jobs,
Acolytes can become ^3131FFPriests^000000,
the apostles of mercy, or ^3131FFMonks^000000
who carry out God's wrath.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
二轉時，服事可以成為慈悲的使徒——^3131FF牧師^000000，也可以成為執行神罰的^3131FF武僧^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Priests and Monks can
change to the Transcendent Class
by visiting Valkyrie in Valhalla. Priests can become ^3131FFHigh Priests^000000 and Monks can become ^3131FFChampions^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
牧師和武僧可以前往瓦爾哈拉拜訪瓦爾基里，轉生為進階職業。
牧師可以成為^3131FF神官^000000，武僧則可以成為^3131FF武術宗師^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Did you undertand all that?
Ho ho ho~ No need to try to remember everything right now. You'll get the hang of it.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
聽明白了嗎？
呵呵呵~
不用急著一下子全部記住，以後自然就懂了。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
However, I'm a little busy with
my work right now, so would you deliver this to Priest Gardron in the next building for me?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
不過，我現在有些忙。
能不能幫我把這個送給隔壁的加德倫牧師？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Blessing!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
天使之賜福！

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Now I'm going to teach you
about ^FF0000Blessing^000000. This is a holy skill that delivers the blessing of God. Blessing will temporarily raise ^3131FFSTR^000000,^3131FFINT^000000,^3131FFDEX^000000 and remove ^3131FFCurse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
現在我要教你^FF0000天使之賜福^000000。這是一種神聖技能，能傳達上帝的祝福。天使之賜福會暫時提升^3131FFSTR^000000、^3131FFINT^000000、^3131FFDEX^000000，並解除^3131FF詛咒^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Like Heal,
Blessing can be used
against Undead monsters.
(^3131FFSHIFT + Blessing^000000)
Blessing will actually
place a curse on the Undead.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
和治癒術一樣，天使之賜福也可以對不死系魔物使用。（^3131FFSHIFT + 天使之賜福^000000）
實際上，天使之賜福會對不死系魔物施加詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Blessing can be learned after you learn Level 5 ^3131FFDivine Protection^000000. That's the skill that will increase your resistance to damage from Undead and Demon monsters.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
天使之賜福可以在你學會5級^3131FF天使之護^000000後習得。那是能增加你對不死系和惡魔系魔物傷害抵抗力的技能。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Being able to serve God and
bless others with his glory is a great honor. Well, that's all for this lesson.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
能夠侍奉神，以神的榮耀賜福他人，是莫大的榮幸。
好，這一課就講到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh, yes...!
In the cemetary northwest
of here, I've been taking care of a lost dog. Right now, it's time to feed him.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哦，對了...！
在西北方向的墓地裡，我一直在照顧一隻走失的狗。現在該餵它了。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Sorry for the hassle,
but would you go and
feed the dog for me?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
又要麻煩你了，能替我去喂喂那隻狗嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFSister Asthe gives
you some dog food.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF阿斯忒修女給了你一些狗糧。^000000

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Ah...
I believe
this is a test
given to you by God.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
啊...
我想這是上帝給你的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
You already
know the answer.
Think carefully
and it will come.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你已經知道答案了。
仔細思考，答案就會浮現。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
When you open the
Skill Window, you'll see that you can also learn ^3131FFDemon Bane^000000 and ^3131FFAngelus^000000, depending on your level of Divine Protection.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
開啟技能視窗就能看到，天使之護達到相應等級後，還能學習^3131FF天使之擊^000000和^3131FF天使之障壁^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Now, ^3131FFDemon Bane^000000 increases your Attack Strength against Undead and Demon monsters, so it's useful for those of us who serve God by expelling evil.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
現在，^3131FF天使之擊^000000能增加你對不死系和惡魔系魔物的攻擊力，對於像我們這樣侍奉上帝、驅逐邪惡的人來說非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Once you have learned Level 3 Demon Bane, you can learn ^3131FFSignum Crucis^000000 which decreases the defense of the targeted Undead or Ghost monster.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
當你學會3級天使之擊後，就可以學習^3131FF天使之光^000000。該技能會降低目標不死系或幽靈系魔物的防禦力。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
^3131FFAngelus^000000 increases the defense in your party, including yourself. It is affected by the VIT stat, so the higher your VIT, the better it works.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
^3131FF天使之障壁^000000可以提高隊伍中所有成員（包括你自己）的防禦力。該技能受VIT屬性影響，VIT越高，效果越好。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
That's about it
for Divine Protection.
Let's take a break before
we proceed to the next lesson,
alright? I'll be right here.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
關於天使之護，就講到這裡。
在繼續下一課之前，先休息一下，好嗎？
我就在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
You can learn Increase AGI after you learn Level 3 ^3131FFHeal^000000. True to its name, Increase AGI temporarily increases the ^3131FFagility (AGI)^000000 of its target.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
當你學會3級^3131FF治癒術^000000後，就可以學習加速術。顧名思義，加速術會暫時提升目標的^3131FF敏捷 (AGI)^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Increase AGI
also increases
^3131FFDodge Rate^000000,
^3131FFAttack Speed^000000,
and ^3131FFMovement Speed^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
加速術還能提升：
^3131FF閃避率^000000，
^3131FF攻擊速度^000000，
以及^3131FF移動速度^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Try it for
yourself, okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你自己也試試看，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Like you'd expect, Decrease AGI slows down enemies, reducing their agility, Movement Speed, Dodge Rate and Attack Speed. Its effect is the exact reverse of Increase AGI.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
顧名思義，緩速術能讓敵人變慢，降低敏捷、移動速度、閃避率和攻擊速度。
效果正好與加速術相反。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
The last skill in the Heal skill tree is ^3131FFCure^000000. You can learn Cure after learning Level 2 Heal.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
治癒術技能樹中的最後一個技能是^3131FF治療術^000000。當你學會2級治癒術後，就可以學習治療術。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Cure can remove irregular
statuses like ^3131FFSilence^000000, ^3131FFCurse^000000,
and ^3131FFStone Curse^000000. When used on Undead monsters, Cure will
actually curse them.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
治療術可以解除^3131FF沉默^000000、^3131FF詛咒^000000和^3131FF石化^000000等異常狀態。如果對不死系魔物使用，治療術實際上會對其施加詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
For now, don't forget that the Increase AGI, Decrease AGI and
Cure skills can only be learned
by learning the Heal skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
暫時記住這一點：加速術、緩速術和治療術這三個技能，都必須先學會治癒術才能學習。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Once you become
an Acolyte, you can
learn the ^3131FFRuwach^000000 skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
當你成為服事後，就可以學習^3131FF光獵^000000技能了。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Ruwach is used to detect ^3131FFhidden enemies^000000. Mages have a similar skill called Sight, but only it can only detect enemies. Ruwach will simultaneously detect and
damage hidden enemies.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
光獵用於探測^3131FF隱藏的敵人^000000。魔法師有一個類似的技能叫火狩，但它只能探測敵人。而光獵在探測隱藏敵人的同時，還會對其造成傷害。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
After you have learned Ruwach,
you can learn ^3131FFTeleport^000000. Teleport will instantly send you to a random spot on the map or to your Save Point.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
學會光獵後，就能學習^3131FF瞬間移動^000000。
它可以讓你瞬間到達地圖上的隨機位置，或回到儲存點。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
After learning Level 2 Teleport, you can learn ^3131FFWarp Portal^000000 which will allow you to warp to a Memo Point, or saved destination, by consuming ^FF00001 Blue Gemstone^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
學會2級瞬間移動後，就能學習^3131FF傳送之陣^000000。
消耗^FF00001個藍色魔力礦石^000000，就能傳送到記憶點，也就是預先記下的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Once you have mastered Warp Portal you can ^3131FFremember three Memo Points^000000. You can't save Memo Points in most fields or dungeons, but you can use the ^FF0000/memo^000000 command in
towns and certain fields.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
傳送之陣學到滿級後，可以^3131FF記住三個記憶點^000000。
大多數野外地圖和地下城都不能設定記憶點，城鎮和部分野外地圖則可以用^FF0000/memo^000000命令記錄位置。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Was that confusing?
Just think that Teleport
and Warp Portal allow servants
of God to move swiftly from place
to place.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
聽著有點複雜嗎？
你只要記住，瞬間移動和傳送之陣，都是讓神的僕人往來各地更便捷的技能。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
I have my home and the convent saved as Memo Points, so I simply warp back and forth between work and home.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我就把家和修女院設成了記憶點，上下班都直接傳送，可方便了。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Now...
The last skill
of the Ruwach tree
is called ^3131FFPneuma^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
那麼...
光獵技能樹中的最後一個技能叫做^3131FF光之障壁^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Pneuma shields characters
within a 3*3 block, or a 9 cell area, from ^FF0000long range attacks^000000. If you party with Archers or other Bow users, be careful since you might accidentally block their attacks.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
光之障壁可以保護3*3格（即9格範圍）內的角色免受^FF0000遠端攻擊^000000。如果你與弓箭手或其他使用弓的隊友組隊，請小心，因為可能會意外阻擋他們的攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
There are some Undead monsters
that can attack from a distance, so protecting yourself with Pneuma and attacking with Heal would be a good strategy.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
有些不死系魔物可以進行遠端攻擊，所以用光之障壁保護自己，同時用治癒術攻擊，會是一個不錯的策略。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Now, we've covered some
pretty complicated material in this lesson. Would you like to hear this again?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
好，這節課我們講了一些相當複雜的內容。
你想再聽一遍嗎？

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Move to the next topic.
scripts.translation: 進入下一個話題

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Alright,
give me a moment
to catch my breath~
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
好的，請給我一點時間喘口氣~

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Ho ho!
What a smart Acolyte~
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
呵呵！
真是個聰明的服事~

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Would you do another favor for me again? Please distribute the mail here and to Prontera Church since
I simply don't have the time.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
能再幫我一個忙嗎？
我實在抽不開身，想請你把這些郵件送到修女院各處和普隆德拉教堂。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
It seems that some of these are more urgent than others, so would you please deliver them in a certain order?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
看起來有些信件比其他更緊急，所以請按照特定的順序投遞好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
The first is a package to a worker in the north. His name is ^3131FFVeiner^000000. The next delivery is for ^3131FFHedrick^000000, who's near the convent entrance.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
先送一個包裹給北邊的工人，他叫^3131FF維納^000000。
接下來送給修女院入口附近的^3131FF赫德里克^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
The third one is from the Blacksmith Guild to the ^3131FFBlacksmith^000000 who makes weapons and armor for Monks. The fourth delivery goes to ^3131FFPriest Karven^000000 in the next building.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
第三件是鐵匠公會寄來的，要交給那位為武僧打造武器和防具的^3131FF鐵匠^000000。
第四件送給隔壁的^3131FF卡爾文牧師^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh, and this last delivery is a receipt for ^3131FFPriest Praupin^000000, the priest who told you about me.
Here you go, the letters and packages...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哦，最後這張收據，是給^3131FF普勞頻牧師^000000的，就是介紹你來這裡的那位。
來，收好這些信件和包裹...

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh...!
You don't seem to
have enough space
to carry everything.
Why don't you put some of your things in Kafra Storage first?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哦...！
你好像拿不下這麼多東西。
先把一些物品存進卡普拉倉庫吧？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
The first is a package to a worker in the north. His name is ^3131FFVeiner^000000. The next delivery is for ^3131FFHedrick^000000, who's near the convent entrance.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
先送一個包裹給北邊的工人，他叫^3131FF維納^000000。
接下來送給修女院入口附近的^3131FF赫德里克^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
The third one is from the Blacksmith Guild to the ^3131FFBlacksmith^000000 who makes weapons and armor for Monks. The fourth delivery goes to ^3131FFPriest Karven^000000 in the next building.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
第三件是鐵匠公會寄來的，要交給那位為武僧打造武器和防具的^3131FF鐵匠^000000。
第四件送給隔壁的^3131FF卡爾文牧師^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh, and this last delivery is a receipt for ^3131FFPriest Praupin^000000, the priest who told you about me. Alright, have a safe trip~
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哦，最後這張收據，是給^3131FF普勞頻牧師^000000的，就是介紹你來這裡的那位。
好了，一路順風~

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
We make relationships with other people throughout our lives and our memories of them live on in our hearts, you know.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
人生中，我們不斷與人結緣，有關他們的記憶，也會一直留在心裡。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
When you feel lonely, let those memories shine through your dark gloom. Just thinking about the people you care about can heal your emotional wounds when times are rough.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
孤獨時，就讓這些回憶驅散心中的陰霾。
難熬的時候，想想自己珍惜的人，也能撫平心裡的傷。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Those who can cherish the present can form lasting relationships. They're the first who will embrace happiness in the future. Remember that.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
那些能珍惜當下的人，能建立持久的關係。
他們將是未來最先擁抱幸福的人。
請記住這一點。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
I get the feeling that you have become a good friend to Priest Praupin. I hope that Priest Praupin continues to be a good friend to you as well.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
感覺你已經和普勞頻牧師成了好朋友。
希望他今後也能一直陪伴你，做你的好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Alright then,
the next time we
meet, I will give
you my final lesson.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
那麼，下次我們見面時，我會給你上最後一課。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Water is so commonplace that
we forget that it's at the center of nature. It's very basic, but essential.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
水實在太常見，人們常常忘了它在自然界中的重要地位。
雖平凡，卻不可或缺。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Place the water into a cup like so and focus all of your holy energy like this... And then...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
像這樣把水倒進杯子，將神聖的力量全都集中起來...
然後...

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Aqua
Benedicta!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
天使之淚！

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
This is how you create ^3131FFHoly Water^000000. Remember that your ^3131FFfeet must be touching water^000000 in order to use the Aqua Benedicta skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
這樣就能做出^3131FF聖水^000000。
記住，施展天使之淚時，^3131FF雙腳必須接觸到水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Ho ho~
Well, that's all
I have to teach you.
It may have been rough,
but you did a good job.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
呵呵~
好了，能教你的都教完了。
也許過程有些辛苦，不過你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh! If you go back to the Prontera Sanctuary, I believe you can learn a secret skill. It couldn't hurt to stop by and check.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哦！如果你回到普隆德拉聖堂，我想你可以學會一個秘密技能。不妨去那裡看看。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Well, please don't forget what I've taught you. I hope you look back with fondness at our time together amongst these beautiful flowers. May God bless you~
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
別忘記我教過你的東西。
但願回想起我們在美麗花叢間共度的時光，你會覺得溫暖。
願神賜福於你~

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
With such warm delicious food in your body, all angry feelings will melt away like the snow.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
熱乎乎的美食吃下肚，怒氣也會像冰雪一樣消融。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
I'm not joking!
If you happen to get in a fight with someone close to you, this might help. I'm speaking from life experience, you know.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我可不是說笑！
要是跟親近的人吵了架，不妨試試。
這可是我的親身體會哦。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Hmm...?
What's that?
You have something for me?
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
嗯...？
什麼？
有東西要給我？

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Hmm...?
What's that?
You have something for
me? A letter you say?
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
嗯...？
什麼？
有東西要給我？
你說是一封信？

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Oh...!
You've returned!
Let's see... One...
Two... Three...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
哦...！
你回來了！
讓我看看...一...
二...三...

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
A few days ago, a sister in Prontera
sent me a telegram that citizens had been harmed
by Hornets in the western field,
so she asked the abbey to help with them.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
幾天前，普隆德拉的一位修女給我發來了電報，說西邊的田野有市民被蜂兵傷害了，所以她請求修女院提供幫助。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
A little while ago, the Payon Elder sent me a message. Apparently,
the residents of Payon are being attacked by Zombies.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
剛才，斐揚的長老給我發來了訊息。看來，斐揚的居民正在遭受腐屍的攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
May light always
come and illuminate
the darkness. In times
of hardship, remind us
that there are no miracles
without hope...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
願光明永遠降臨，照亮黑暗。在艱難的時刻，請提醒我們，沒有希望就沒有奇蹟...

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Oh! This is a letter from my mother back home. Thank you for bringing this to me, young Acolyte.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
哦！這是我老家母親寄來的信。謝謝你把它帶給我，年輕的服事。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
I've worried about
her, especially since
she is getting old now, but I'm relieved to hear that her health
is good. We are truly blessed...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
我一直很擔心她，尤其是她現在年紀大了，但聽到她身體很好，我鬆了一口氣。我們真是有福了...

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Well, it seems that
you must have forgotten
it or misplaced it somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
看來，你是忘了帶，或者把它弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Thank you very much!
You've done a great job
on behalf of the convent,
not to mention the fact that
you've protected the citizens
of {0} from danger.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
非常感謝！
你為修女院做了很大的貢獻，更不用說你還保護了{0}的市民免受危險。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
May you always
be blessed. Now, you
should return to Sister
Asthe to continue your
Acolyte training.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
願祝福永遠與你同在。
現在回阿斯忒修女那裡，繼續服事的訓練吧。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
But at this time,
we are also short of hands...
so it's a big problem.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
可眼下我們也缺人手...真是難辦。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
....!
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
...！

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
May I entrust you, acolyte {0},
this urgent matter?
Please dispose of Hornets
which are causing trouble on ^FF0000the western field of Prontera^000000.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
服事{0}，我可以把這件緊急的事情託付給你嗎？
請去處理那些在^FF0000普隆德拉西邊的田野^000000造成麻煩的蜂兵。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
I know that you are undergoing the discipline,
So I will give you something to help you
if you bring me ^3131FF 5^000000 ^3131FFBee Sting^000000.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
我知道你正在接受修煉，所以如果你能帶給我^3131FF5個^000000^3131FF蜂針^000000，我會給你一些幫助。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Will you go to Prontera?
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
你要去普隆德拉嗎？

scripts.text: Let's go to Prontera!
scripts.translation: 去普隆德拉！

scripts.text: I'll be back after doing some preparation.
scripts.translation: 我先做些準備再回來

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Okay, I will send you to Prontera.
Please dispose of Hornets and bring me 5 Bee Stings for confirmation.
My Lord, please protect this acolyte from evil monsters.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
好的，我會送你去普隆德拉。
請消滅蜂兵，並帶給我5個蜂針以作確認。
主啊，請保護這位服事免受邪惡魔物的侵害。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
He has requested the convent for help, but we've got a big problem. We're running out of people here that can deal with this situation...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
他向修女院求助，可我們這邊也很為難。
能處理這種事的人手，實在不夠了...

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
....!
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
...！

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
{0},
may I ask
you to take care
of this task? Exterminate the Skeletons and Zombies in the
First Floor of Payon Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
{0}，我可以拜託你處理這件事嗎？請消滅斐揚地下城第一層的邪骸戰士和腐屍。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Since you're still in basic training, I will give you some
help if you return with
^3131FF5 Decayed Nails^000000.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
既然你還在基礎訓練中，如果你能帶回來^3131FF5個亡者指甲^000000，我會給你一些幫助。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Now then...
Will you go to Payon?
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
那麼...
你要去斐揚嗎？

scripts.text: Let's go to Payon!
scripts.translation: 去斐揚！

scripts.text: Um, let me get ready first.
scripts.translation: 嗯，讓我先準備一下

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Good, good.
I shall send you
there to fight the monsters in Payon Dungeon so that you can return with 5 Decayed Nails. May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 加德倫]
好，好。
我送你去斐揚，到地下城消滅魔物，帶回5個亡者指甲。
願神賜福於你...

scripts.text:
[Dog]
^CDB79EBark bark!
Woof woof!^000000
Give a treat.
scripts.translation: 喂零食

scripts.text: Pet the dog.
scripts.translation: 撫摸狗

scripts.text: End actions.
scripts.translation: 結束互動

scripts.text:
[Dog]
^CDB79EGrrrrrr...!^000000
scripts.translation:
[狗]
^CDB79EGrrrrrr...!^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe dog grinds
its teeth and glares
at you menacingly.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF那隻狗齜著牙，兇狠地瞪著你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dog]
^CDB79ERoof roof!^000000

[Dog]
^CDB79ERoof roof~^000000

[Dog]
^CDB79ERoof roof!^000000

[{0}]
So cute~!

[Angelic]
Thanks for helping me.
I'm sad my older sister is no longer with me, but I oughta
cheer up, right? I'll try my best!
scripts.translation:
[安潔莉可]
謝謝你幫助我。
雖然姐姐已經不在了，讓我很難過，但我應該振作起來，對吧？我會加油的！

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
Sister, don't go...
^333333*Sniff* *Cough cough!*^000000
It h-hurts so... much...!
Sis...ter...

[Angelic]
^333333*Sniff...*^000000
Are you from
the convent?
scripts.translation:
[安潔莉可]
^333333*吸吸鼻子...*^000000
你是從修女院來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
Save...
My sister...
scripts.translation:
[安潔莉可]
救救...我姐姐...

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
^333333*Sniff sniff*
^333333*Cough cough*
H-hurts...
Are you alright?
scripts.translation: 你還好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
My sister...
She was so beautiful...
She was such a nice girl.
But then, one day...
scripts.translation:
[安潔莉可]
我姐姐...
她那麼美麗...
她是個那麼善良的女孩。
可是有一天...

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
This disgusting looking
person was coated in this icky stuff and attacked her. She was poisoned and her body became
colder and... ^333333*Sniff*^000000
scripts.translation:
[安潔莉可]
有個很噁心的傢伙，渾身黏糊糊的，突然襲擊了她。
她中了毒，身體越來越冷，然後...^333333*吸吸鼻子*^000000

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
I was with her and I got sick too. I wasn't poisoned as badly, but
my whole body feels heavy and I've been having these nightmares...
scripts.translation:
[安潔莉可]
我當時就在她身邊，所以我也生病了。雖然我沒有中毒那麼嚴重，但全身都很沉重，而且一直做噩夢...

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
^333333*Cough cough!*^000000
Will I join my
sister like this?
scripts.translation:
[安潔莉可]
^333333*咳 咳!*^000000
我也會這樣...去找姐姐嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis girl looks
really sick. Maybe you
should take a better look
and see what's wrong.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這個女孩看起來病得很重。也許你應該仔細檢查一下，看看她怎麼了。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is....!
A cursed spirit
is tormenting this
poor young girl!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是...！
有個帶著詛咒的惡靈，正在折磨這個可憐的女孩！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll cure you...
For sure.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會治好你的...
一定可以。

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
It hurts...!
I... I can't...!
scripts.translation:
[安潔莉可]
好痛...！
我...我受不了了...！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou go towards
the girl, place your hands
on her back and perform
a holy spell...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你走向那個女孩，把手放在她的背上，施展神聖法術...^000000

scripts.text: Heal!
scripts.translation: 治癒術！

scripts.text: Blessing!
scripts.translation: 天使之賜福！

scripts.text: Cure!
scripts.translation: 治療術！

scripts.text: Recovery!
scripts.translation: 痊癒術！

scripts.text: Signum Crucis!
scripts.translation: 天使之光！

scripts.text: B.S Sacramenti!
scripts.translation: 聖之祈福！

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
It doesn't look like
that skill will work.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF毫無反應。
看來這個技能不起作用。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
B...
Blessing!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天...天使之賜福！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I...
I did it!!

^3355FFWhat a great
chance for you to
practice your abilities!
It seemed that this good
deed has improved your skills.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這正是運用所學本領的好機會！
看來，這次善舉也讓你的技藝有所精進。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
It's not working...
Maybe it's because
I'm still learning?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦...？
沒有效果...
也許是因為我還在學？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou didn't learn
this skill yet, so you're
not able to use it for now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你還沒有學會這個技能，所以現在無法使用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
It doesn't look like
that skill will work.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF毫無反應。
看來這個技能不起作用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou didn't learn
this skill yet, so you're
not able to use it for now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你還沒有學會這個技能，所以現在無法使用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis isn't a skill
that Acolytes can use...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這不是服事能用的技能...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
S-Signum...
Signum Crucis!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天、天使...天使之光！

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
It doesn't look like
that skill will work.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF毫無反應。
看來這個技能不起作用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou didn't learn
this skill yet, so you're
not able to use it for now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你還沒有學會這個技能，所以現在無法使用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis isn't a skill
that Acolytes can use...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這不是服事能用的技能...^000000

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
Ah...
I feel...
So relaxed.
So much lighter...
scripts.translation:
[安潔莉可]
啊...
感覺好舒服，身體輕了好多...

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
Did you
do this?
Is this the
power of God?
scripts.translation:
[安潔莉可]
是你做的嗎？
這就是神的力量嗎？

scripts.text:
[Veiner]
So very exhausted...
Should I just go back home?
scripts.translation:
[維納]
好累啊...
我還是回家吧？

scripts.text:
[Veiner]
I can't wait
to see her again!
Bibi...! I loooove you!
scripts.translation:
[維納]
我迫不及待想再見到她！
比比...！我超...超愛你！

scripts.text:
[Veiner]
So very
exhausted...
Would you help
me carry my stuff?
P-please...
scripts.translation:
[維納]
好累啊...
你能幫我拿一下東西嗎？
求...求你了...

scripts.text:
[Veiner]
What's that?
You have a delivery
for me? Why, what
ever could it be?
scripts.translation:
[維納]
什麼？
有我的包裹？
哎呀，會是什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Veiner]
This is...!
It's Handmade Chocolate
from my honey bunny!
Oh Bibi! You're the best!
scripts.translation:
[維納]
這是...！
是我親愛的比比送的手工巧克力！
哦比比！你最棒了！

scripts.text:
[Veiner]
Oh right!
Thank you very much for delivering this to me. Sorry, but I'm always excited to hear from my cutie pie~
scripts.translation:
[維納]
對了！
非常感謝你把它送到我這裡。抱歉，我一收到我寶貝的訊息就總是這麼興奮~

scripts.text:
[Hedrick]
^333333*Whew!*^000000
Man I worked hard today!
And so efficiently too!
Awesome job as usual,
Hedrick. You're number one!
scripts.translation:
[赫德里克]
^333333*呼!*^000000
今天干活真賣力，效率也高！
赫德里克，你還是一如既往地出色啊！
你最棒了！

scripts.text:
[Hedrick]
Oh...?
Is this letter for me?
I wonder who it's from.
Ah, it's from my mom!
scripts.translation:
[赫德里克]
哦...？
這封信是給我的嗎？
不知道是誰寄來的。
啊，是我媽媽寄來的！

scripts.text:
[Hedrick]
Whoa...!
Holy cow!
This letter is
full of the energy
of motherly love!
scripts.translation:
[赫德里克]
哇...！
天哪！
這封信充滿了母愛的力量！

scripts.text:
[Hedrick]
Thanks a lot!
Here, why don't
you have one of the
cookies she sent me?
scripts.translation:
[赫德里克]
非常感謝！
來，嚐嚐她寄給我的餅乾吧？

scripts.text:
[Weapon Merchant]
The stuff I requested from the guild is finally here!
It's pretty tough to keep everything in stock since this is such a remote place.
scripts.translation:
[武器商人]
我從公會訂購的東西終於到了！
因為這裡地處偏遠，保持庫存充足相當困難。

scripts.text:
[Weapon Merchant]
Hey, thanks so much!
Oh, and come here if
you need anything, okay?
scripts.translation:
[武器商人]
嘿，非常感謝！
哦，如果你需要什麼，隨時過來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karven]
May you rest
in peace forever...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾文]
願您永遠安息...

scripts.text:
[Karven]
May you rest
rest in peace...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾文]
願您安息...

scripts.text:
[Karven]
I'm saying prayers
for the recently departed.
If it's not urgent, please
come again at another time.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾文]
我正在為新近逝者祈禱。
如果不急的話，請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Karven]
A letter?
Oh. It must be from
my younger sister.
What could she want
this time?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾文]
一封信？
哦。一定是我妹妹寄來的。
她這次又想要什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Karven]
I hope she realizes
the word of God and returns
to living a good life once
again. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾文]
希望她能領悟神的教誨，重新過上正直的生活。
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
Hi, hi~
I'm Gloria.
You wanna know
something neat
about my name?
scripts.translation:
[格洛麗亞]
嗨，嗨~
我叫格洛麗亞。
想聽聽我名字背後的趣事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
I'm still
a young Acolyte
in training and I'm
always making mistakes!
scripts.translation:
[格洛麗亞]
我還是個見習服事，正在修煉，老是犯錯！

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
Wow...
Did you learn all that from Asthe? That's so great...
You must be so much better than me that I can't even brag about warping to
Prontera anymore. ^333333*Sniff*^000000
scripts.translation:
[格洛麗亞]
哇...這些都是阿斯忒教你的？
真厲害...
你比我強這麼多，我都不好意思再炫耀自己能傳送到普隆德拉了。
^333333*吸吸鼻子*^000000

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
My father was a Blacksmith in Geffen, and supposedly he finished an incredible weapon on the day
I was born. He thought it was a sign of good luck, so he named
the weapon after me!
scripts.translation:
[格洛麗亞]
我的父親是吉芬的鐵匠，據說在我出生的那天，他完成了一件不可思議的武器。他認為這是好運的象徵，所以用我的名字給那件武器命名了！

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
It's a little strange knowing that there's a weapon named after
you, but I like my name very much. I mean, it's not like my parents named me after that weapon, right?
scripts.translation:
[格洛麗亞]
有件武器跟自己同名，想想是有點怪，不過我很喜歡這個名字。
畢竟又不是照著武器給我起的名字，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
^333333*Sniff*^000000
And I get scolded
almost all the time...
But there's one thing
that I can do really well!
scripts.translation:
[格洛麗亞]
^333333*吸吸鼻子*^000000
而且我幾乎總是被責罵...
但有一件事我做得非常好！

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
Warp portal!
I know Level 2 Warp Portal!
One of my Memo Points is here
and the other is in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[格洛麗亞]
傳送之陣！
我會2級傳送之陣！
一個記憶點在這裡，另一個在普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
Anyway, whenever
you need to, I can
send you to Prontera.
Just let me know, okay?
scripts.translation:
[格洛麗亞]
總之，如果你需要的話，我可以把你傳送到普隆德拉。
只要告訴我就行，好嗎？

scripts.text: I'm okay for now.
scripts.translation: 暫時不用了

scripts.text: Send me to Prontera.
scripts.translation: 把我傳送到普隆德拉

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
In order to use
Warp Portal, you need
one ^3131FFBlue Gemstone^000000.
Is this to help me?
Wow, I'm touched!
scripts.translation:
[格洛麗亞]
使用傳送之陣需要一塊^3131FF藍色魔力礦石^000000。
這是為了幫我嗎？
哇，太感動了！

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
Leave it to me!
Here we go~!!
W-warp Portal!
scripts.translation:
[格洛麗亞]
交給我吧！
開始啦~！！
傳...傳送之陣！

scripts.text:
Wow...
Did you learn all that from Asthe? That's so great...
You must be so much better than me that I can't even brag about warping to
Prontera anymore. ^333333*Sniff*^000000
scripts.translation:
哇...這些都是阿斯忒教你的？
真厲害...
你比我強這麼多，我都不好意思再炫耀自己能傳送到普隆德拉了。
^333333*吸吸鼻子*^000000

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Oh my.. 
A newbie Acolyte?
It doesn't even seem
like you've learned
that many skills?
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
哎呀...
一個新手服事？
看起來你好像還沒學多少技能呢？

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Oh my.. 
A young Acolyte?
You seem to have just
started learning your skills?
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
哎呀...
一個年輕的服事？
你看起來好像剛開始學技能？

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Well, well, well~
Hello, young Acolyte.
You're still kind of
green, but I guess you're
not exactly a beginner either.
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
哎呀，哎呀，哎呀~
你好，年輕的服事。
你還算是個新人，但也不完全是初出茅廬了。

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Hmmm?
It looks like you've
learned quite a lot as
an Acolyte! I hate to admit it,
but you're too good for me to
call you a rookie anymore~
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
嗯？
看來你這服事已經學了不少本事啊！
雖然不想承認，不過你這麼厲害，我也不好再叫你菜鳥了~

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Hello hello.
The sun is very
warm today, don't
think? Very pleasant
weather today...
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
你好你好。
今天的陽光很溫暖，不是嗎？
今天的天氣非常宜人...

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Ho ho~!
In my days
as an Acolyte,
I trained by fighting those ^3131FFdisgusting cockroaches^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
呵呵~!
在我當服事的時候，我是靠打那些^3131FF令人作嘔的蟑螂^000000來訓練的。

呵呵~!
在我當服事的時候，我是靠攻擊^3131FF綠色青蛙^000000來訓練的，直到我的指關節都打出血了！

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Ho ho~!
In my days
as an Acolyte,
I beat up ^3131FFwooden sticks
about to collapse^000000 and these
^3131FFhuge mushrooms^000000 all the time!
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
呵呵~!
我當年還是服事時，整天打那些^3131FF搖搖欲墜的木棍^000000，還有^3131FF大蘑菇^000000！

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Ho ho~!
In my days
as an Acolyte,
I trained by fighting ^3131FFZombies^000000 in the dungeon of that town with all of those trees.
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
呵呵~!
在我當服事的時候，我是靠在那個長滿樹木的城鎮的地下城里打^3131FF腐屍^000000來訓練的。

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Ugh...
Actually, that's not such a good memory when I think about it.
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
唉...
仔細想想，那其實不是什麼美好的回憶。

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
You'll have to go through a lot until you reach the point where I'm at right now. Ho ho ho! You still have a looong way to go~
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
想達到我如今的境界，你還得好好歷練。
呵呵呵!
路還長著呢~

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Good luck...
Rookie.
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
祝你好運...
新人。

scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
呵呵~!
在我像你這麼大的時候，我會去和那些^3131FF白老鼠^000000還有^3131FF大蟑螂^000000打架~

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Ho ho~!
When I was
around your age,
I'd walk straight into the
^3131FFdepths of the ocean^000000 to find monsters to hunt.
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
呵呵~!
在我像你這麼大的時候，我會直接走進^3131FF深海^000000去尋找魔物狩獵。

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Ho ho~!
When I was
around your age,
I used to fight ^3131FFcreepy
looking tree monsters^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
呵呵~!
在我像你這麼大的時候，我會去和那些^3131FF長相詭異的樹魔^000000戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Ho ho~!
When I was
around your age,
I used to fight hundreds
of ^3131FFuuuuuug~ly orcs^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
呵呵~!
在我像你這麼大的時候，我會去和幾百只^3131FF醜——死了的獸人^000000戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Ho ho~!
When I was
around your age,
I would fight the ^3131FFmonkeys
in front of the convent^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
呵呵~!
在我像你這麼大的時候，我會去和^3131FF修女院前面的猴子^000000戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Those were
bad memories.
If someone told me
to go there again,
I'd go insane.
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
那是很糟糕的記憶。
如果有人讓我再去那裡，我肯定會發瘋的。

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Still, it seems you
have a long way to go
until you become a well
experienced Acolyte. Ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
不過，想成為經驗老到的服事，你還有很長的路要走。
呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Good luck,
young friend.
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
祝你好運，年輕的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
I remember that when
I was your age, I used to
play with these ^3131FFcute
Poporings^000000 all the time!
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
我記得在我像你這麼大的時候，我總是和這些^3131FF可愛的波波利^000000玩在一起！

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
I remember that when
I was your age, I used to

[Cleope Verce]
I remember that when
I was your age, I used to
fight these ^3131FFfearsome evil spirits^000000 all the time in that castle ^3131FFwest of Geffen^000000. I wonder how I survived
all that?
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
想當年，像你這麼大的時候，我老是去跟^3131FF可怕的惡靈^000000戰鬥，就在^3131FF吉芬西邊^000000那座城堡裡。
真不知道自己怎麼活下來的？

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
I remember that when
I was your age, I used to
fight with ^3131FFgun shooting ghosts!^000000 Sure, they were scary, but beating them was a piece of cake if you have Pneuma!
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
我記得在我像你這麼大的時候，我總是和^3131FF會開槍的幽靈^000000戰鬥！
沒錯，它們很可怕，但如果你有光之障壁，打敗它們簡直是小菜一碟。

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
I remember that when
I was your age, I used to
beat up those ^3131FFarrow shooting devils^000000 almost everyday in the castle west of Geffen. Boy, was there a lot of them back then.
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
我記得在我像你這麼大的時候，我幾乎每天都在吉芬西邊的城堡裡揍那些^3131FF會射箭的惡魔^000000。
天哪，那時候它們可真多。

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
I remember that when
I was your age, I used to
battle these really ^3131FFfat pigs^000000. They were pretty strong, so they always gave me a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
想當年，像你這麼大的時候，我老是跟那些大^3131FF胖豬^000000打。
它們力氣可不小，害我吃了不少苦頭。

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
I remember that when
I was your age, I used to
beat up these ^3131FFliving chunks of
sand in the desert^000000. I swear, they were alive!
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
想當年，像你這麼大的時候，我老是揍那些^3131FF沙漠裡會動的沙塊^000000。
我發誓，那些沙塊真是活的！

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Still, I had to be careful from their attacks. At that time they were pretty strong!
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
不過，我還是得小心它們的攻擊。
那時候它們可是很強的！

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
Ah, memories~
Of course, if I had
the chance to do it all
over again, I don't know
if I would take it...
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
^333333*嘆氣*^000000
啊，回憶~
當然，如果我有機會重新來過，我不知道我是否還會選擇那樣做...

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Anyway, you have
plenty of adventures
waiting for you. I hope
you'll make many fond
memories when you're
still an Acolyte.
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
總之，你還有很多冒險在等著你。
我希望你在還是服事的時候，能留下許多美好的回憶。

scripts.text:
[Cleope Verce]
Good luck,
young friend~
scripts.translation:
[克萊奧佩·維爾斯]
祝你好運，年輕的朋友~

scripts.text:
[Sound by Window]
...
scripts.translation:
[窗邊的聲響]
...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's some kind
of noise coming from
yonder window...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF那邊窗戶裡好像有動靜...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThere's nothing here.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡什麼都沒有。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064Sir...
Something doesn't
seem right at the palace.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^A68064大人...
王宮裡好像出了什麼事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600What's wrong?
Did something happen?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^CD6600怎麼了？
發生什麼事了嗎？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064I'm not sure.
I can't explain exactly what it is, but the officials seem frightened about something. Maybe there
was some sort of accident?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^A68064我也不清楚，具體說不上來，可那些官員好像在害怕什麼。
難道出了意外？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Hmm, I wouldn't know.
Why don't we just wait and see
what happens? I'm sure the truth will come out one way or another.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^CD6600嗯，我哪知道。
不如就等著看吧，真相總會水落石出的。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064 Alright, sir.
Still, I can't help
but feel uneasy...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^A68064好的，大人。
不過，我還是感到有些不安...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064I heard from an
official at the palace
that they're requesting
us for an exorcism.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^A68064我聽王宮裡的一位官員說，他們想請我們去驅魔。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Exorcism?
Did Zombies attack
the kingdom or something?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^CD6600驅魔？
難道是腐屍襲擊王國了嗎？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064No, I don't think
that's the case, but
they are requesting
a highly skilled holy person...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^A68064應該不是，不過他們點名要一位法力高強的神職人員...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Hmm...
I wonder what
exactly is going on...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^CD6600嗯...
真不知道到底發生了什麼...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064I will inform you
as soon as I hear
something.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^A68064一有訊息，我會立刻通知您。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Thank you...^000000

[Voices from Window]
^A68064...Sir, do you know anything about the ^855E42curse of the Gaebolg family^A68064?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^A68064...大人，您聽說過^855E42吉爾伯格家族的詛咒^A68064嗎？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600The Gaebolg?
Are you telling me
there's a curse on
the royal family?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^CD6600吉爾伯格？
你是說王室有詛咒？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064Yes...
That may be why his
highness, King Tristam III,
and his courtiers have been
acting strangely lately...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^A68064是的...
也許這就能解釋，為什麼特里斯坦三世陛下和朝臣們最近舉止那麼反常...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064You see...
Yormungard is
said to have cursed
the Gaebolg family when Rune-Midgarts was first established.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^A68064您看...
據說在盧恩·米德加茲建國之初，耶夢加得就詛咒了吉爾伯格家族。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Yormungard?!
How can we hope
to combat its magic?
Not even the Asgardians
could deal with that
giant serpent's power!^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^CD6600耶夢加得？！
我們怎麼可能對抗它的魔法？
連阿斯加德人都無法應對那條巨蛇的力量！^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064It's horrible...
Because of the curse,
the first child of every generation of the Gaebolg family will supposedly die an early death...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^A68064太可怕了...
據說受詛咒影響，吉爾伯格家族每一代的頭一個孩子都會早夭...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Are you saying that all of the first princes and princesses
have died to this day? If this is true, it'd cause trouble if word got out...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^CD6600你是說，歷代頭一個出生的王子或公主，無一倖免？
若真如此，訊息傳出去，麻煩可就大了...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Is that what happened
in the palace? Did the eldest prince pass away recently?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^CD6600這就是王宮裡發生的事？
大王子最近去世了？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064 No...
Actually, the second
eldest prince passed
away, not the first.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^A68064不...
實際上，是二王子去世了，不是大王子。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600What!?^000000

[Voices from Window]
^A68064L-lower your voice!^000000

[Voices from Window]
^CD6600So...
How did it happen?
Was it an accident?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^CD6600那麼...
這是怎麼發生的？
是意外嗎？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064 They haven't determined
the exact reason of the death yet. But the court officials want us to see if we can undo Yormungard's curse once and for all.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^A68064目前還沒有確定確切死因。但朝廷官員希望我們能看看，是否有可能徹底解除耶夢加得的詛咒。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Yormungard's curse?
Is it possible to remove it after so many years? Such ancient
magic may be too powerful for
any of us in the Church...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的聲音]
^CD6600耶夢加得的詛咒？
過了這麼多年，還能解除嗎？如此古老的魔法可能太強大了，我們教會裡沒人能辦到...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voice from Window]
^A68064This task is monumentally huge!
And if we should fail, we'd lose the faith of our constituents. The Church and the Royal Court truly need a miracle...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗邊的聲音]
^A68064這項任務艱鉅無比！
如果我們失敗了，就會失去信眾的信任。教會和王室真的需要一個奇蹟...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voice from Window]
^CD6600Well, what's the Church's response? Are we really going to send someone to lift the curse of a monster that can challenge the Asgardians?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗邊的聲音]
^CD6600那麼，教會的回應是什麼？我們真的要派人去解除那個能挑戰阿斯加德人的魔物的詛咒嗎？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voice from Window]
^A68064I'm not quite sure.
Those that might have
the necessary skill are
too old. Still, they're
not giving up hope...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗邊的聲音]
^A68064我不太確定。
那些可能具備必要能力的人都太老了。不過，他們並沒有放棄希望...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voice from Window]
^A68064This situation is very important to the reputation of the royal family and stability of the kingdom, so everyone's been very careful
about keeping quiet.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗邊的聲音]
^A68064事關王室聲譽和王國安定，大家都謹慎得很，不敢透露半點風聲。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voice from Window]
^A68064For now, I'll return to the kingdom and let you know if I hear of any other news. Still, since everyone needs to be so careful, it may be
a while until I learn anything new.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗邊的聲音]
^A68064我先回王國，有別的訊息再通知您。
不過，大家都這麼謹慎，恐怕一時半會兒也打聽不到什麼新訊息。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voice from Window]
^CD6600Thank you very much.
I'll be waiting to hear
from you again.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗邊的聲音]
^CD6600非常感謝。
我會等待你的訊息。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voice from Window]
^CD6600Oh dear God.
Please expel the darkness that approaches the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Please protect us with your light and compassion.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗邊的聲音]
^CD6600神啊，請驅散逼近盧恩·米德加茲王國的黑暗。
請以您的光明與慈悲護佑我們。^000000
